mechanism.hold_budget: LockLedger installs a budgeted Runner for every holder (run pass, callback, outside check, timeout-ack, decide, dispatch, claim): each subprocess gets min(timeout, time left), none starts with < 1.5 s left (ErrBudget, no receipt recorded for an unsent wake); ExecRunner.WaitDelay 0.5 s so a killed process's lingering child cannot stretch it. B = 10 s.
mechanism.yield: Tick starts a unit (held release, package advance, outbox drain, escalations) only with >= 6 s left, else yields between units (never mid-transition); pass record 'yielded'; run continues at once; run retries on E_LEDGER_BUSY instead of exiting
mechanism.due: ProcessDue on acquire (and before release): oldest first, only within the budget, leftovers to the next holder; unsettled > 20 s -> SATURATED report to duty (once a minute); callback waits 8 s, writes the marker, keeps trying to 22 s and settles due work itself

arithmetic.per_hold: <= 10 s + 0.5 s WaitDelay + local SQLite/CPU; measured max 10.51 s
arithmetic.detection: marker (trusted durable evidence) by D + 1 (AccuracySec) + 8 = D + 9 s; direct settlement by D + 19.5 s
arithmetic.settlement_head_of_queue: <= D + 9 + 10.5 (current hold) + 10.5 (next holder settles due first) ~= D + 30 s; measured <= 18 s
arithmetic.ack: authenticated ack within 60 s of detection is human; proved only live
arithmetic.capacity: >= 1 due settlement per hold; a backlog of k markers needs about k holds; beyond that SATURATED is reported; new dispatches under overload get E_LEDGER_BUSY (visible); no finite latency for unbounded arrivals

residuals: Local SQLite and file operations inside a hold are not budgeted (only subprocesses); measured holds include them (max 10.51 s).

A unit started with >= 6 s left can still have its later I/O refused (ErrBudget) if an earlier I/O used most of the remainder; e.g. a verifier timer create refused -> the package goes blocked (owned, visible), not lost.
The yield path is shown by unit test; the real-process runs never needed a yield (run passes were short).
Crash/reopen under contention is not rerun in this round (marker durability and replay were shown in bounded-deadline evidence).
Settlement bound ~D+30 s holds for the marker at the head of the due queue; deeper backlog -> SATURATED report (capacity statement above).
